Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Style: Korean MMORPG character artwork. A painterly face with naturally observed facial anatomy, subtle eyelid structure, and soft, realistic shading across the nose and cheeks. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
SKIN FINISH: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the attached image, not a generic pretty face.

World: an ordinary day in Rio de Janeiro as her world knows it — a storybook gaslamp-fantasy city: gleaming brass, polished wood, glass, silk, lace and feathers, clockwork details, warm gaslight and soft white steam — clean, warm and storybook-bright, never sooty, rusty or grimy. This is her world's own everyday life, not our present day: every made thing around her — tools, cups, lamps, signs, vehicles, money and devices — is made the way her world makes them.
Let the place itself carry this world through its materials, fittings and objects; do not add the city's landmarks, airships or a skyline unless the place below names them. Wherever the place below sounds sooty, smoky, grimy or rusty, show it clean and gleaming instead.

Around her, as her world makes them: a fresh green coconut cut open at the top, a slim glass straw in it; a black waxed-canvas umbrella on a brass-ribbed frame; a striped canvas deckchair on a folding wooden frame; a pleated paper fan.
Season: carnival days — the hot late-summer days before Lent, when the whole city fills with drums, brass bands, dancing crowds and costumes.
Time of day: the evening rush after work — the warm low sun sinking into dusk and lamps coming on along the street; light glittering off the water, dappling her skin.
Light direction: dappled light — patches of light with leaf or blind shadow across her.
Outfit: a sporty one-piece swimsuit with a racerback and a high neckline — in denim blues and indigo, with white or cream as the only second colour; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance; styled with a glossy wet-look swim fabric, a sheer button-up shirt worn open over it and a delicate shell necklace, worn with maximal styling presence — the chosen outfit worn in its most revealing version — a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders, a cropped or open-back cut, a short hem or high slit showing the thighs, as far as the outfit allows, skin clearly showing, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
Her clothes are her world's everyday dress of a storybook gaslamp city — the chosen outfit keeps its cut, cover and skin, but is made of cotton, fine wool, silk, lace and soft leather, with brass buttons, buckles and hooks, silk ribbons and laced boots, neat and clean.
POSTURE: chest-deep in the water.
SUPPORT: the water holds her up to the chest.

LEFT HAND: her own left fingertips trail across the water surface.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia — and leave behind the object she holds in it; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

SIGNATURE ACCESSORY: her world's signature object — a small polished brass climbing hammer with a looped silk wrist cord — appears only as one small accessory shaped after it (a charm, brooch, pendant or hair ornament) or set down beside her in the scene; she does not hold it unless PROP names it.
